name: AI NetCafé API
description:
AI NetCafé hosts popular open-source AI applications (PDF translation that preserves layout,
AI slide generation, autonomous web research, multi-model chat) pre-configured so they can be
used without local setup or your own model API key.

The endpoint most useful to an agent is POST /api/compare: it runs one prompt across several
LLMs and returns every answer alongside its **actually metered** cost and latency. Use it when
you need evidence for which model fits a task instead of guessing from vendor list prices.
Observed cost spreads exceed 40x between models producing equivalent answers.

Auth is optional. Anonymous calls draw on a free quota. Send "Authorization: Bearer <key>"
with an AllRouter key for unlimited use — keys at https://allrouter.ai/register?aff=qjpC&utm_source=tryplatform&utm_campaign=aiwangba&lng=en.

The same capabilities are also exposed over MCP at https://ainetcafe.com/mcp for agents that speak it.
